up: Find compounds selective for target CHEMBL301 over target CHEMBL4036. Selectivity is defined as having an IC50 value strictly less than 50 nM against CHEMBL301 and an IC50 value strictly greater than 200 nM against CHEMBL4036. Only consider activity rows where standard_type is 'IC50', standard_units is 'nM', and standard_relation is '='. Return exactly two columns: compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles.
sql:
WITH hits_301 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.molregno
    FROM activities a
    JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
    JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
    WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL301'
      AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
      AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
      AND a.standard_relation = '='
      AND a.standard_value < 50
  ),
  hits_4036 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.molregno
    FROM activities a
    JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
    JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
    WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4036'
      AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
      AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
      AND a.standard_relation = '='
      AND a.standard_value > 200
  )
  SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles
  FROM hits_301 h1
  JOIN hits_4036 h2 ON h1.molregno = h2.molregno
  JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON h1.molregno = md.molregno
  JOIN compound_structures cs ON h1.molregno = cs.molregno
